title: Daily batch or streaming for the order report
audience: Product managers new to data pipelines
one_liner: Batch gives one final number a day; streaming gives a number that keeps changing.

analogy.text: Batch is like counting the cash drawer once after closing. Streaming is like watching the register total tick up all day.
analogy.limits: A register total is always right for that moment; a streaming metric can be revised later when late events arrive.

ladder.analogy: Count once at closing, or watch the total tick all day.
ladder.truth: ADR-0007 keeps the daily order report on batch aggregation because finance needs a fixed end-of-day number that can be recomputed before reconciliation; streaming is used only for alert dashboards.
ladder.caveat: The batch report is only available the next morning around 06:00, so intraday anomalies must be caught by alerts instead.

scenes.title: Two ways to get a number
scenes.caption: Both read the same orders; they differ in when the number is considered final.

nodes.label: Orders as they happen
nodes.note: Each order is an event with a paid or unpaid status.

failure_lens.what_breaks: Late-arriving events after the batch has run
failure_lens.symptom: Yesterday's number changes after finance already used it

teach_back.question: Why not stream everything if it is faster?
teach_back.answer: Finance needs a number that stops changing; a streaming total keeps moving as late events arrive, so it cannot be the reconciliation baseline.

glossary.plain: Checking that the report matches the money that actually arrived.

evidence.claim: The daily order report stays on batch aggregation; streaming is only for real-time alert dashboards
evidence.quote: 訂單日報維持每日批次聚合；串流只用於即時告警看板

evidence.claim: Orders arrive as events and some arrive late
evidence.reasoning: Typical of order pipelines with retries; no late-event measurement was collected for this report.

mode_data.decision_rule: If a number must stop changing before someone signs off on it, use batch; if a number only needs to trigger an alert, use streaming.

recommendation.because: Finance reconciliation needs a fixed end-of-day figure, which ADR-0007 records as the deciding reason.
